command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== construct a gene: 40 codons in 2 exons, CODON 20 SPANNING THE SPLICE JUNCTION =="
CDS='ATGGCTCTGGAAAAGTTCGGTCACATCAACCCGCAGCGTAGCACCGTGTGGTACGATTGCGCACTCGAGAAATTTGGACATATTAATCCACAACGAAGTACAGTTTGTTATGACGGCTAA'
PROT='MALEKFGHINPQRSTVWYDCALEKFGHINPQRSTVCYDG*'
E1=${CDS:0:59}; E2=${CDS:59:61}
printf '%s\n' "$PROT" > protein.txt
awk -v e1="$E1" -v e2="$E2" 'BEGIN{
  srand(7); b="ACGT"
  r=""; for(i=0;i<99;i++)  r=r substr(b,int(rand()*4)+1,1)
  n=""; for(i=0;i<96;i++)  n=n substr(b,int(rand()*4)+1,1)
  t=""; for(i=0;i<681;i++) t=t substr(b,int(rand()*4)+1,1)
  seq = r e1 "GT" n "AG" e2 t
  print ">chrA"
  for(i=1;i<=length(seq);i+=60) print substr(seq,i,60)
}' > chrA.fa
printf '>transcript:GENEA.1\n%s\n' "$CDS" > cds.fa

SEQ=$(awk '!/^>/{printf "%s",$0}' chrA.fa)
at() { printf '%s' "$SEQ" | cut -c"$1"; }

echo "== fixture self-checks: this must be a valid gene before any tool sees it =="
awk -v c="$CDS" -v p="$PROT" 'BEGIN{
  if (length(c)!=120)         {print "FIXTURE: CDS is not 120 bp"; exit 1}
  if (length(p)!=40)          {print "FIXTURE: designed protein is not 40 residues"; exit 1}
  if (substr(c,1,3)!="ATG")   {print "FIXTURE: no start codon"; exit 1}
  if (substr(c,118,3)!="TAA") {print "FIXTURE: no terminal stop codon"; exit 1}
  for(i=1;i<=117;i+=3){ k=substr(c,i,3)
    if(k=="TAA"||k=="TAG"||k=="TGA"){printf "FIXTURE: internal stop at codon %d\n",(i+2)/3; exit 1} }
  print "fixture_cds\t120 bp / 40 codons / ATG..TAA / no internal stop"
  print "fixture_exons\t59 bp + 61 bp -- codon 20 spans the junction, so exon2 CDS phase is 1"
}' | tee fixture.txt
test "$(at 159)$(at 160)" = GT || { echo "FIXTURE: donor is not GT"; exit 1; }
test "$(at 257)$(at 258)" = AG || { echo "FIXTURE: acceptor is not AG"; exit 1; }
printf 'fixture_splice\tcanonical GT..AG intron at 159-258\n' | tee -a fixture.txt

echo "== GFF3 that BOTH annotators accept (Ensembl-style ID prefixes) =="
{
printf '##gff-version 3\n##sequence-region chrA 1 1000\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\tgene\t100\t319\t.\t+\t.\tID=gene:GENEA;Name=GENEA;biotype=protein_coding\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\tmRNA\t100\t319\t.\t+\t.\tID=transcript:GENEA.1;Parent=gene:GENEA;Name=GENEA.1;biotype=protein_coding\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\texon\t100\t158\t.\t+\t.\tParent=transcript:GENEA.1\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\texon\t259\t319\t.\t+\t.\tParent=transcript:GENEA.1\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\tCDS\t100\t158\t.\t+\t0\tID=CDS:GENEA.1;Parent=transcript:GENEA.1\n'
printf 'chrA\ttoy\tCDS\t259\t319\t.\t+\t1\tID=CDS:GENEA.1;Parent=transcript:GENEA.1\n'
} > genes.gff

echo "== five variants, coordinate order; every REF base read from the fasta =="
{
printf '##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n##contig=<ID=chrA,length=1000>\n'
printf '#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\n'
printf 'chrA\t108\tv1_syn\t%s\tA\t.\t.\t.\n'   "$(at 108)"
printf 'chrA\t121\tv2_mis\t%s\tT\t.\t.\t.\n'   "$(at 121)"
printf 'chrA\t160\tv5_spl\t%s\tA\t.\t.\t.\n'   "$(at 160)"
printf 'chrA\t269\tv3_non\t%s\tT\t.\t.\t.\n'   "$(at 269)"
printf 'chrA\t298\tv4_fs\t%s%s\t%s\t.\t.\t.\n' "$(at 298)" "$(at 299)" "$(at 298)"
} > variants.vcf
grep -v '^##' variants.vcf

echo "== planted truth: read off the codons the fixture was BUILT from, not off any tool =="
{ printf 'v1_syn\tsynonymous\t3\tL\tL\n'
  printf 'v2_mis\tmissense\t8\tH\tY\n'
  printf 'v3_non\tstop_gained\t24\tK\t*\n'
  printf 'v4_fs\tframeshift\t.\t.\t.\n'
  printf 'v5_spl\tsplice_donor\t.\t.\t.\n'; } | sort > truth.tsv
awk -F'\t' -v p="$PROT" '$3!="." { r=substr(p,$3,1)
  if (r != $4) { printf "TRUTH/DESIGN mismatch at codon %s: designed %s, truth says %s\n",$3,r,$4; exit 1 } }
  END{ print "truth_vs_design\tevery truth ref-AA matches the designed protein" }' truth.tsv | tee -a fixture.txt

echo "== build the snpEff database from that GFF, checked against the constructed CDS =="
mkdir -p data/chrA
cp chrA.fa data/chrA/sequences.fa; cp genes.gff data/chrA/genes.gff; cp cds.fa data/chrA/cds.fa
printf 'data.dir = ./data\nchrA.genome : ToyGene\nchrA.chromosomes : chrA\n' > snpEff.config
snpEff -version > snpeffver.txt 2>&1
SEV=$(awk 'NR==1{print $2}' snpeffver.txt)
snpEff build -c snpEff.config -gff3 -noCheckProtein -v chrA > build.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 build.log; exit 1; }
grep 'CDS check:' build.log
read -r CDSOK CDSERR <<<"$(awk -F'\t' '/CDS check:/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){if($i ~ /^OK: /)o=$i; if($i ~ /^Errors: /)e=$i}
  gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",o); gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",e); print o, e; exit}' build.log)"
test "$CDSOK" = "1"  || { echo "snpEff did not check the CDS -- GFF/transcript-id mismatch"; exit 1; }
test "$CDSERR" = "0" || { echo "snpEff CDS check found $CDSERR errors -- GFF coordinates or phase are wrong"; exit 1; }

echo "== annotate =="
snpEff ann -c snpEff.config -noStats -hgvs1LetterAa -no-downstream -no-upstream -no-intergenic \
  chrA variants.vcf > ann.vcf 2> ann.log
NANN=$(awk '!/^#/{n++} END{print n+0}' ann.vcf)
test "$NANN" = "5" || { echo "expected 5 annotated records, got $NANN"; exit 1; }
if grep -q 'ERROR_' ann.vcf; then echo "snpEff emitted ERROR_ codes:"; grep -o 'ERROR_[A-Z_]*' ann.vcf | sort -u; exit 1; fi
grep -v '^##' ann.vcf | cut -f3,8

echo "== normalise snpEff's spelling, then compare to the planted truth =="
cat > norm-snpeff.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{FS="\t"; OFS="\t"}
!/^#/{
  ann=""; n=split($8,parts,";")
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if (parts[i] ~ /^ANN=/) ann=substr(parts[i],5)
  split(ann,f,"|")
  csq=f[2]; sub(/&.*/,"",csq); sub(/_variant$/,"",csq)
  p=f[11]; pos="."; r="."; a="."
  if (p ~ /^p\.[A-Z*][0-9]+[A-Z*]$/) { t=substr(p,3); r=substr(t,1,1); a=substr(t,length(t),1); pos=substr(t,2,length(t)-2) }
  print $3, csq, pos, r, a
}
AWKEOF
awk -f norm-snpeff.awk ann.vcf | sort > snpeff.norm
cat snpeff.norm
if diff -q truth.tsv snpeff.norm >/dev/null; then SNPEXACT=yes; else SNPEXACT=no; diff truth.tsv snpeff.norm || true; fi
test "$SNPEXACT" = yes

{
printf 'snpEff annotation -- five constructed variants vs the consequences the fixture was built from\n'
printf 'snpeff_version\t%s\n' "$SEV"
printf 'cds_check\tOK %s / Errors %s   (assert 1 / 0 -- snpEff extraction from the GFF equals the constructed CDS, phase and junction included)\n' "$CDSOK" "$CDSERR"
printf 'variants_annotated\t%s   (assert 5)\n' "$NANN"
printf 'snpeff_error_codes\tnone   (assert none)\n'
printf 'snpeff_exact\t%s   (assert yes -- EXACT vs planted consequences)\n' "$SNPEXACT"
} | tee smoke-check-snpeff.txt
echo "SNPEFF CHECK PASSED"
